ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

21. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
